methods.description: Make a convenient pronumeral the subject if needed, substitute into the other equation, solve the one-pronumeral equation and substitute back for the second value.

When one pair of coefficients already has equal size, add for opposite signs or subtract for the same signs; solve and substitute back. Explain an unsuccessful add/subtract choice using the resulting equation.
Rearrange if needed and multiply one or both entire equations to match one pair of coefficients; add or subtract consistently, solve, then substitute back.
